Jamie (Convex CEO) here.

Convex is a full platform for building and hosting your software. We store your data and code, and we have an AI gateway that developers use to build their software or power in-app features.

We had a project called Convex Chef (https://x.com/convex/status/1910453755851718833), an end-to-end vibe-coding product. We shut it down recently. The prompt upload in this plugin powers the Convex “quickstart” feature, which is the spiritual successor to Chef. It bootstraps an entire new project in one prompt. We’ll review this code to make sure it’s handling everything responsibly and transparently—but it is working as intended, and it’s fair to say that it’s only the tip of the iceberg of the IP you entrust to Convex (assuming we earn your trust).

If people have more questions, fire away.

KPGv2 · Nov 28, 2026

> default opt-out

The term you're looking for is "opt in"

opt-out means "we assume you want telemetry turned on. you have to disable it yourself"

"Opt" here means "to choose" so "opt out" means "you [must] choose 'out' [because it's not pre-set that way]"

"Default opt-[anything]" is meaningless because "opt" is the user choosing something, and "default" is the non-user choosing something. They're terms in opposition to each other.

It's like saying "this car is default configured with your choices." It's not possible, because you're describing something other than a default.
